question.text: Fund-level due diligence for a Cat III AIF should assess:

answer.text: Service providers, compliance/regulatory, internal controls and business continuity/disaster recovery

explanation.text: The Logic: Fund-level due diligence covers operational, regulatory/compliance, strategy and reputational risks, including internal controls, service providers and disaster recovery / business continuity arrangements. The Trap: Returns, stock picks or fee negotiation alone do not represent the fund-level due diligence agenda the workbook describes. Note: Use a fund-level checklist that spans service providers, compliance and regulatory checks, internal controls and BCP/DR — separate from investee-level financial/business DD.
